subject: Unusual sign-in to your wallet
body:
We noticed a sign-in to your Coinbin wallet from a new device.

Device: Windows PC
Location: Unknown

If this was you, no action is needed. If not, please verify your account within 24 hours to avoid a temporary hold on withdrawals.

Verify your account: coinbln.com/verify

Coinbin Security
Coinbin will never ask for your password by email.
